user.title: OutGauge listener
user.description: Home Assistant listens for OutGauge UDP packets. In BeamNG.drive enable OutGauge under Options → Other and set the IP to this Home Assistant instance and the port below.

data_description.host: Local address to bind to. 0.0.0.0 listens on all interfaces.
data_description.outgauge_id: Only accept packets with this ID. 0 accepts all packets.

error.cannot_bind: Cannot listen on this address and port. Is it already in use?
error.unknown: An unknown error occurred. Please try again later.

abort.already_configured: This address and port are already configured.

data_description.update_interval: How often entity states are updated. BeamNG sends far more packets than Home Assistant should record.
data_description.timeout: Mark the game as disconnected after this many seconds without packets.
